Subject: Re: Intro + POC goals / next steps

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. High-level notes from the call:

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for FinLytics’ document classification + structured extraction pipeline to reduce manual review and lower per-document processing cost.
- Proposed POC scope: ingest ~10k historical documents, run classification + extraction on a sample (2k) and evaluate precision/recall on extraction fields, and run a 1k/day streaming simulation for latency/cost.
- Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
  1) Extraction field accuracy >= 92% on the validation set
  2) End-to-end processing latency (median) < 350ms per document for the streaming sim
  3) Cost per processed document <= $0.03 with recommended batching + caching profile

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize data access & security checklist; sign off POC plan
- Week 1 (May 13 start): environment + connector setup; dry-run with subset of data
- Week 2 (May 20): full run on validation set; weekly sync and handoff of results

Owners:
- FinLytics: Emily Zhang (project lead), Rajiv Menon (data owner), Tom Harris (security)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE / POC owner), Dylan Brooks (infra lead), Rishi Malhotra (solutions / model config)

Attachments: FinLytics-POC-Plan.xlsx, SOC2-Infra-Checklist.pdf
Link: https://drive.google.com/finlytics/poc-plan

Please confirm the success criteria and the May 13 start date. Once confirmed, I’ll kick off infra provisioning and send the access checklist to your security team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
